_comment: Voting intention since the previous election. One object per published poll. `date` is the publication date as YYYY-MM-DD; `fieldwork` is free text and may be null. `values` maps a template code to a percentage — omit a party entirely for a poll that did not prompt for it, which leaves a gap in the chart rather than plotting a zero. Put the previous election itself in as the first row, with pollster set to its name, so the series starts from a real result.
_partiesComment: Which parties to plot, as codes, in legend order. Empty plots every party that appears in at least one poll below.
